theme.palette_name: Royal Navy & Gold with Soft Blush & Ivory Fusion
theme.primary_aesthetic: Classic & Traditional Royal Luxury fused with Modern Minimalist Elegance

brand_identity.name: World of Weddingz (WOW)
brand_identity.tagline: The Premier Royal Matrimony & Wedding Ecosystem
brand_identity.vibe: Extremely premium, mesmerising, royal palace luxury, architectural precision, regal warmth

hierarchy_ceiling_rules.H1_Hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy_ceiling_rules.H2_Section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal tracking-normal leading-snug text-royal-navy-900 dark:text-gold-lit

glassmorphism.header_nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-royal-navy-900/85 border-b border-gold/20 shadow-sm
glassmorphism.floating_card: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 dark:bg-royal-navy-800/70 border border-gold/25 shadow-lifted

layouts_and_grids.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32 with generous internal padding on containers
layouts_and_grids.bento_mode: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for hero & marketplace showcases (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8)
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid for Dashboards & Analytics (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6)

buttons.primary: btn: bg-royal-navy-900 hover:bg-royal-navy-800 dark:bg-gold dark:hover:bg-gold-lit text-white dark:text-royal-navy-950 uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-xs font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-none border border-gold/40 transition-all duration-200 active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.outline: btn-outline: border border-gold text-gold-dark dark:text-gold-lit hover:bg-gold/10 uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-xs font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-none transition-all duration-200
buttons.secondary_blush: btn-blush: bg-soft-blush-100 hover:bg-soft-blush-200 text-royal-navy-900 border border-gold/20 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-none font-medium text-xs uppercase tracking-wider

inputs.standard: input: bg-surface border border-gold/30 dark:border-gold/40 focus:border-gold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-gold/20 rounded-none px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-400 text-sm min-h-[48px]

cards.royal_card: card: bg-surface border border-gold/20 dark:border-gold/30 p-6 rounded-none shadow-sm hover:border-gold/50 transition-all duration-200
cards.raised_card: card-raised: bg-surface-raised border border-gold/35 p-6 rounded-none shadow-lifted

navigation_header.rules: Fixed/sticky with z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-royal-navy-950/90, border-b border-gold/20, brand logo left, nav items centered, CTAs & profile right

sidebar.rules: Royal navy background with gold accents, clear group headers, active states highlighted with gold border-l-2 and gold soft glow background

motion.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease
motion.prefers_reduced_motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by setting duration to 0.01ms

testing.attribute_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="register-submit-button")

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT change website functionality or backend API integration.
Focus 100% on UI/UX redesign: CSS custom properties in index.css, tailwind configuration, layout elegance, typography balance, and micro-interactions.
Implement the Royal Navy (#0A1128) & Struck Gold (#C5A059) fused with Soft Blush & Warm Ivory palette.
Ensure headings use Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display and body text uses Plus Jakarta Sans / Outfit / Karla.
Apply generous padding (p-6, p-8) and keep sharp/subtle rounded square edges (border-radius: 0 to 2px) to match the royal stationery aesthetic.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and interactive controls.
